basic_info.description: Set in one of San Franciscos most iconic locations at the foot of Coit Tower this condominium building was designed by acclaimed architect Gardner Dailey, circa 1940. Entire walls of glass at the front and rear present glamorous views of the skyline, Bay, and Bay Bridge. Refinished hardwood floors, remodeled kitchen, and two bedrooms (one customized as an office) and each with updated en suite bath and access to a wonderful covered porch. Adding appeal is secure garage parking for one car. And, just blocks away fine restaurants, cafes, and chic boutiques for the best of City living!
